## Findings

I've investigated the responsive utility implementation and scaffold template consumption. Here are the concise findings:

### (1) Responsive Utility Class Syntax

From [formats/components/src/utilities/responsive/index.ts](formats/components/src/utilities/responsive/index.ts):

- **Hide at or below breakpoint**: `.instui-hidden-max-<bp>` (also bare `.-hidden-max-<bp>`)
- **Hide at or above breakpoint**: `.instui-hidden-min-<bp>` (also bare `.-hidden-min-<bp>`)
- **Show at or below breakpoint**: `.instui-show-max-<bp>` (inverse of `-hidden-min`, shown via `display: revert`)
- **Show at or above breakpoint**: `.instui-show-min-<bp>` (inverse of `-hidden-max`)
- **Container query variants**: `-cq-` infix (e.g., `.instui-cq-hidden-max-sm` reacts to `.instui-container` ancestor width)

**Breakpoint tiers** (scale + themed):
- Scale: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl` (short) + `x-small`, `small`, `medium`, `large`, `x-large` (long) + `mobile`, `phablet`, `tablet`, `laptop`, `desktop` (device names)
- Themed: `content`, `content-full-width` (canvas theme: 59.25em both; rebrand: 68.75em and 98.75em)

**For your specific needs**:
- Hide below `sm`: `.instui-hidden-max-sm` (hide when viewport ≤ breakpoint)
- Hide below `md`: `.instui-hidden-max-md`
- Padding below `lg`: Use spacing utility (`.instui--p-<size>` or bare `.-p-<size>`) separately; responsive utilities handle visibility only

### (2) Template CSS Already Imported

[main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L8) line 8 already imports `@pantoken/components/utilities.css`, so responsive classes are available.

**No CSS import changes needed**; responsive utility selectors are already present. [app.css](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/app.css) and [app.html](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/app.html) can add classes directly—no inlining required.

### (3) Analogous Existing Usages & Tests

- **Test reference**: [formats/components/tests/utilities/responsive.test.ts](formats/components/tests/utilities/responsive.test.ts) (lines 9–51) shows all selector patterns and breakpoint aliases

